author: ojiudezue
title: v5.96.1 shipped: Egress EXIT identity via backfill (conservative, exclusive attribution)
summary: Egress EXIT identity via backfill (conservative, exclusive attribution)
why: Exit crossings were never named because the departer's BLE not_home edge lags the door crossing by ~369s (D0 median), past the +45s resolver read. Backfill the null exit row when the edge fires, but only when attribution is unambiguous — the reviews showed naive nearest-match swaps co-departers, so the decision is deferred to the row's window-close and abstains unless exactly one resident departed in the window. Operator directive: accuracy over coverage, leave null rather than write a wrong name.
implications: Shipped EGRESS-EXIT-IDENTITY-BACKFILL-1 at v5.96.1; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.96.1.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Post-restart: a real solo departure fills its exit-row person_id within ~10min and _ble_exit_backfilled_count moves; a co-departure or flap leaves person_id null (ambiguity/flap counters move) rather than writing a wrong name

refs.release_notes: Completes the egress producer: exit crossings (written null at +45s) get person_id backfilled when the departer's BLE not_home edge fires ~369s later. Conservative/exclusive: deferred window-close decision + distinct-departer count (no co-departer swap), flap guard (settle re-read), per-slug cooldown (no multi-tracker double-consume), idempotent IS-NULL single-use, UTC-naive tz contract. Accuracy over coverage: ambiguous cases stay null. Tier-3: prior-art scan + plan-review + 3 framing-disjoint build reviews + fix-up + adversarial re-review + targeted fix + orchestrator mutation-verify.
